role: Exact read-only conditional information and binary-error-classification audit for two separate base-versus-peer pairs under both public actions, not full-IID or logical-risk inference
question: At the common selected complete first public record, does either fixed action's complete second public record distinguish the base private initial red-X error from either J7T peer under that pair's already declared restricted IID p_X=1/10 prior?
source_basis: J7R identifies absence of a random private-error estimand in the single-error fixture
J7T fixes both five-edge peers and separate base-versus-candidate restricted-pair prior weights
J7V supplies normalized complete second public laws for the base and both peers under both actions
J7M pins the same complete first public record, first mass and public actions

frozen_model.geometry_and_channel: J7V paper-normalized periodic L=2 ideal D4 projector orbit and frozen 36-red-edge IID physical red-X p_X=1/10, p_Z=0 prior; no new error support, rate, observation, action or source model.
frozen_model.conditioning: Condition separately on each two-support set {base initial error [0,4,3], one J7T five-edge peer} and on the same selected full first binary flux/charge/vacuum record. The candidate weight q=1/325 is recomputed from physical IID support probabilities times first-record masses 1/4 versus 1/16, not inferred from second outcomes.
frozen_model.public_actions: The two relation-free corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] are frozen before observing private error or second record. Compare each base/candidate likelihood under the same action and second public flux; no online private field is exposed.
frozen_model.second_observation: J7V's complete 24-site action-conditioned second public flux/charge/vacuum record, using only its public subobject as the likelihood key. Private operator and error fields remain offline scoring provenance.
frozen_model.estimand_boundary: Conditional mutual information I(E;O2|selected first record, restricted pair, fixed action), complete-law total variation, posterior candidate probability and minimum 0-1 binary error-identity classification risk. This is not logical-sector information, Boolean-union logical failure risk, full-IID-channel information or JIT schedule performance.

matrix.design: Exactly two separate base-versus-peer restricted prior pairs times both frozen actions; do not collapse the pairs or choose a favorable action after seeing data.
matrix.analysis: For each full-public-record key r, use exact rational likelihoods P0(r),P1(r); mixture m=(1-q)P0+qP1; posterior q_r=qP1/m; total variation 1/2 sum|P0-P1|; mutual information H2(q)-sum m H2(q_r), cross-checked against the KL form; prior-only binary classification risk min(q,1-q); record-aware risk sum_r min((1-q)P0(r),qP1(r)). Exact law equality must force TV=0, posterior=q, information=0 and no classification-risk reduction.
matrix.uncertainty: All source probabilities and prior weights are exact rationals for a finite deterministic fixture. Entropy is evaluated in floating bits and two algebraically equivalent forms must agree to 1e-12 bit. No sampling unit or statistical interval applies; selection/conditioning limits scope.
matrix.integrity: Pin source laws/contracts before and after, replay their completion and base controls, verify common first record/masses and identical action-conditioned flux, use only full public record keys, exact rational positivity/normalization, posterior/mixture normalization and Bayes non-worsening.

acceptance: All four input pins and runner pin pass before and after
Both registered peers and public actions replay with the same complete first record, base/candidate first masses and exact restricted-pair posterior q=1/325
Each of four comparisons uses only normalized complete public second laws under the same flux/action, never private outcome fields
Exact TV, posterior and Bayes binary error-classification risks pass normalization and non-worsening; the two mutual-information formulas agree within 1e-12 bit
Report null as a conditional two-support negative result, not a full-IID or logical-risk null; report positive as restricted-pair information only
No new Born terms, stochastic histories, policy arms, bootstrap or threshold work

outcomes.all_four_null: The selected second public record has zero binary private-error information for both base-versus-peer pairs under both fixed actions at this selected first record; pursue a new separately registered physical-error geometry or stop this pair branch, not a budget increase or favorable-action selection.
outcomes.some_positive: Retain the exact restricted-pair information result and register separate sensitivity/identifiability work before any full-IID or logical-risk claim.
outcomes.censored: On pin, provenance, public-key, flux, normalization, prior, entropy or CPU failure, release no information or risk conclusion.

stop_rule: Stop after four read-only pair/action law contrasts or sooner on a gate failure. No new exact Born law, physical sample, full-IID posterior, unconditional logical-loss score, policy evaluation, bootstrap or threshold fitting.
